newsitem.title: USA: Virginia Power sees Surry 2 fully back Sat.
newsitem.headline: Virginia Power sees Surry 2 fully back Sat.

text.p: Virginia Power said Friday its 781 megawatt Surry 2 nuclear power unit would resume full production Saturday after returning on line later today.
"Unit 2 is critical. We're a matter of hours from being on on line. We should be back up to 100 percent in the next 24 hour period," said a company spokesman.
Surry 2 was taken off line Tuesday after losing power in its electrical hydraulic control system.
Meanwhile, the adjoining Surry unit 1, with identical generating capacity, is expected to begin dispatching power to the grid Saturday, the spokesman said.
"Unit 1 is scheduled to be on line tomorrow," he said.
Surry 1 was shut late Wednesday for repairs after a pressure drop in the reactor coolant system was detected.
The Surry units are in Gravel Neck, Va.
Virginia Power is a subsidiary of Dominion Resources.
